geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the lifted bar in a courtyard macro to create public void while keeping the dominant mass ancestry intact.
Deepen the carved perimeter to produce a usable open-space figure.
Orient the public opening toward the access edge to strengthen street threshold legibility.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant lifted bar into a courtyard-bearing macro so the mass preserves its primary gesture while generating a usable public void.
Open enough perimeter to make the void legible as public ground rather than a decorative subtraction.
Align the court opening with the verified access side so the street edge becomes an active threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant bar with a clear primary direction, so gesture and hierarchy are strong. It is also properly contained within the parcel and does not show obvious collisions across views. The main weakness is that the road frontage edge is answered only weakly: the mass largely seals the access side rather than forming a clearly public threshold, court, or undercut. Still, for a neighborhood-living / neighborhood commercial brief, the mass can plausibly support program because the bar form can house repeated floor plates and a calm upper volume, even though the ground response is underdeveloped. The silhouette is simple but not incoherent; it avoids the arbitrary stair/pyramid failure mode. Overall this is a passable early-stage massing with good anchor and repair integrity, but it needs a carved public void aligned to the verified access edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is hospitality/commercial rather than neighborhood living, so copy the public-threshold logic only.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact bar mass with a clear ground threshold and a controlled public edge; useful as a restraint precedent, not as a literal form model.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-oriented neighborhood frontage with a strong enclosure/opening relationship that can support active ground space.

warnings: Ground/public-edge response is too thin for the program brief; the access side should become more legible as a threshold.
Void publicness is the weakest concept score; a courtyard, notch, or undercut would better activate the frontage.
The form is somewhat generic and box-like, but not enough to fail program fit at this stage.
